description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - The Sabaragamuwa P/C Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 01 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of an appropriation statute (Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 01 of 2017) for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It details the legislative process (certification, assent, passing) and amends the financial estimates and allocations for the 2017 financial year. This fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette, which includes "New laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "Legal amendments, repeals, or modifications." While it involves a government body (the Provincial Council), the core content is a legislative/regulatory amendment, not a personnel or structural change, making Type 5 the correct classification.
